data.body: Landed: https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/1029 (merged as 5083da432, LLM-Review +1, Verified +1, 0 unresolved). Replaced T11's unconditional POST-ROLLBACK SCHEMA STATE paragraph with the four-condition applicability rule ((a) changes interpretation of existing persisted records, (b) rewrites/migrates records in place, (c) removes/narrows a read path, (d) one-way transformation with no back-out) plus the anti-FP line for purely additive backward-compatible changes; no store technology named in the rule itself. Contract tests in tests/unit/test_plan_review_t11_rubric.py (5 passing); docs/plan-review-criteria-guide.md regenerated via python -m rebar.llm.plan_review.registry regenerate-criteria-guide. Gates: make lint, make typecheck, 542 plan_review unit tests green.
